analyticalMisses.summary: One hot F5 day on 8/29 was not proof of a durable manual edge; 8/30 F5 went 3-5.
SEA F5 + SEA TT created correlated exposure and both lost (SEA scored 0).
MIL F5 + MIL TT + a parlay leg created excessive game-level concentration.

NYM confidence was too high given Ethan Pecko had only 8 MLB innings / 2 starts. Tiny starter samples must reduce confidence materially; recent FIP is useful supporting evidence but too noisy to be the main handicapping anchor.

analyticalWins.summary: BAL F5 was a clean multi-signal winner.
ATL F5 winning while ATL TT lost reinforces that side/horizon and team-run thresholds are separate propositions.
PHI F5 had a defensible starting-pitcher thesis but lost; not every loss is a process error.

gameLevelConcentration.note: MIL F5 (-30) + MIL 5+ (-15) + parlay leg (-10): excessive one-game concentration, all lost.
SEA F5 (-30) + SEA 5+ (-15) + parlay leg (-10): correlated exposure, SEA scored 0.

performanceByMarketFamily.note: Exact-cash convention: cost 224.99, paid out 137.31, ROI -38.97%. WSH, ATL, BAL won; BOS, LAD, SEA, MIL, PHI lost.
SEA 5+, ATL 5+, MIL 5+, NYM 5+ all lost.
Exact-cash convention: cost 19.98, P/L -19.98. Both 4-leg parlays lost.

processErrors.summary: LAD actual stake was $40; the earlier suggested stake was smaller. Actual execution preserved, not the recommendation.

proposedInvestigations.summary: Team-total stake normally should remain <= half of the primary side unless an independent pricing/offense case is unusually strong (manual sizing guidance only).
Cap combined exposure on one game thesis (manual sizing guidance only).
$10 parlays remain entertainment/overlay positions only. Do not chase losses.
